name: check
wording: The one command that shows cratylus's own code works, the same locally and in CI with nothing before or after it: building, linting, type-checking and deterministic tests of composition, projection and the runtime's capabilities. It needs only what the repository declares, installed by ordinary package management, and checks nothing else a machine has installed. Every part gives the same result for the same code; none starts a harness or an agent or calls a model, so no inference decides whether a change merges, and how well agents work in a harness is judged in use, never by it.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
